basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo settled in the heart of San Francisco. This delightful home boasts beautiful hardwood floors and inviting darker tones that create a cozy and comfortable ambiance The open floor plan is a great space to entertain & includes the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, making laundry days a breeze. Additionally, the property includes two single-car garages, providing secure and ample parking. Perfectly situated close to the vibrant North Beach neighborhood, this condo offers both style and functionality in a prime location.
